name: Poteto-style Chief of Staff
tagline: Runs your bench of bots lean: few timers, short specialists, coding sent elsewhere
description: A fleet of agents usually goes wrong by accumulating scheduled runs that nobody needs any more. This one takes the opposite approach, keeping timers scarce, pushing anything repetitive onto small single-purpose helpers and sending development work out to cloud agents, then coordinating the whole bench.
author: HaseebMir91
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
